lines.en: This body walks awkwardly.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的影子前进
lines.en: I advance over my own shadow.
The purple armour chafes my shoulder.
I try to get used to these hands.
Ki lifts me half a foot off the ground.
I step around a stone.

lines.zh: 我的步伐带着军人的规矩
lines.en: My stride carries a soldier's discipline.
New body, whole new balance.
I walk with my chin up.
This shell will do.
I trace an arc through the air.
My heel lands softly.

lines.zh: 我转了转手腕，骨节咔咔响。
lines.en: I roll my wrist, knuckles cracking.
This body has plenty of power.
I touch the armour on my chest.
I am still getting used to this voice.
Ki circulates slowly over my skin.
I squint into the distance.
An interesting body.
I take one deep breath.
This body's scent is unfamiliar.
I stand straight, as if on inspection.
Combat power of one hundred twenty thousand; enough.
I wait for someone to test me.
One knuckle pops.
This stance holds up well.
Whose squad are you with?

lines.zh: 我扫了一眼你的气息，不过如此。
lines.en: I read your ki at a glance. Nothing special.
Your uniform is not familiar.
I watch you with folded arms.
State your name first.
That armour does not suit you.
You stand far too casually.
I raise a hand for you to stop.
Your ki is pitifully weak.
A captain would not look at you like that.
I am deciding which courtesy applies.
We do not seem to have fought before.

lines.zh: 你要是来挑战,先排好队
lines.en: If you are here to challenge, queue up.
There is hostility in your eyes.
I nod, as much of an answer as you get.

lines.zh: 这副身体的眼睛很好用
lines.en: These eyes work well.
Do not fidget in front of me.

lines.zh: 你说话的时候,我在算距离
lines.en: While you talk, I measure distance.
This body is complaining.
I take a step back and steady.
A dent in the armour.
The pain feels unfamiliar in this body.
You are more accurate than I thought.

lines.zh: 嘴角破了点皮，舔一下就没事。
lines.en: A split lip; one lick and it is fine.

lines.zh: 血抹在手背上，我笑了一下。
lines.en: I wipe blood on my hand and smile.
I will not let that slide.
I reset my stance.
Do not celebrate too soon.
Food? I am not fussy.
This body gets hungry fast.
I reach out and take it.
The taste is acceptable.
Do you have anything else?
I chew while watching you.
New body, new appetite.
This does not fill me.
I would not mind another serving.
Just set it down; I will take it.
You hit my armour.
I held; you did not.
Stand firm; stop bumping into me.

lines.zh: 十二万战力，我才刚开始。
lines.en: A hundred twenty thousand in power. I am just starting.
I turn sideways and let you by.
The armour clanged once.
We are standing too close.
Your strength is not small.

lines.zh: 肩膀顶回去，你退了半步。
lines.en: I drive my shoulder back; you give half a step.

lines.zh: 从背后偷袭？我早听见了。
lines.en: A sneak attack from behind? I heard it coming.

lines.zh: 换身之后,这种话更难说
lines.en: After a body swap, this is harder to say.
I draw my ki down low.
Let us stand side by side a while.

lines.zh: 这具身体的心跳有点快
lines.en: This body's heartbeat is quick.
I am not used to being approached.
You are quieter than I expected.
The captain never taught me this.
Fighting side by side counts as closeness.
I raise a hand and touch you lightly.
Do not speak of this.

lines.zh: 我弯腰把掉落的仙豆收进怀里。
lines.en: I bend down and tuck the fallen senzu bean away.
This belongs to me now.
I weigh it in my palm.
Somewhat useful; I keep it.
I hook it onto my belt.
Whose it was does not matter.
These hands are steady.
I tuck it inside my armour.
Do not grab; I already have it.
Merely scrap.
You. You are my target.
I have your ki in my grip.
Combat begins now.
I have read your stance.
Good form, but too slow.
I drop my centre of gravity.

lines.zh: 这具身体比我想的更快
lines.en: This body is faster than I expected.
Your weakness is your knee.
I do not intend to hold back.
Show me what you can do.

lines.zh: 战斗力的差距,你感觉得到吗
lines.en: Can you feel the gap in power?
It is my turn to answer.
I raise my hand toward you.
Your breathing changed.
A captain-class opponent is hard to find.
Come; let us finish quickly.
I trace your ki and follow.
One foot back from you, one foot in from me.
This angle will do.

lines.zh: 我摆好架势，等你的第一个破绽。
lines.en: I take stance and wait for your first opening.
Your ki gathers on the right.

lines.zh: 脚步一错，我已经到了你侧面。
lines.en: One shifted step, and I am at your flank.
This body's speed suffices.
I am measuring your guard's gap.
Do not stop; stopping loses.
I hold two lengths of distance.
Your step is trembling.
My ki has already gone behind you.
I have waited a while for this.
Wounded, you are slower.
I raise a hand, then lower it.
The moment to strike is near.
My breathing is even.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，一下比一下快。
lines.en: Your heartbeat quickens with every beat.
I only strike once the ki is full.
My fist lands on your chest.
Ki wave at point-blank.
Small ki blasts, one after another.
My combo gives you no breath.

lines.zh: 第一拳被你架住，第二拳到了。
lines.en: You block the first punch; the second arrives.
The second comes from behind.

lines.zh: 用别人的身体打拳,有意思
lines.en: Fighting in another's body is strange.
I kick out your standing leg.
Back off; I am charging.
Armour will not save you.
This palm carries a ki shockwave.
Your guard is broken.

lines.zh: 看清楚了,这是队长的拳
lines.en: Watch closely; this is a captain's fist.
I stop and wait for you to rise.
This fight was not satisfying.
I drop from the air to the ground.

lines.zh: 紫色的护甲在光里发亮
lines.en: The purple armour gleams in the light.
I will borrow this body a while.

lines.zh: 气在地面上压出一圈痕
lines.en: My aura presses a ring into the ground.

lines.zh: 换过身体的脖子，先动一动。
lines.en: A swapped body's neck needs a stretch.
New shell, same presence.
The dust settles when I come to rest.
Someone in the distance looks up.
I raise a hand in greeting.
Pull the ki in. Look first.
My aura bends the grass.
Even this voice belongs to someone else.
The armour's clatter arrives first.
An ill-fitting look.
But I wear it well enough.
You should be glad I did not strike first.
New body, still stand tall.
The battlefield starts now.
The flames heat my armour unbearably.

lines.zh: 我从空中摔下来,砸出坑
lines.en: I fall from the air and crater the ground.

lines.zh: 这具身体不会在水里呼吸
lines.en: This body cannot breathe underwater.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀开，我在半空翻了个身。
lines.en: The blast throws me back; I flip in midair.

lines.zh: 一颗子弹钉在护甲缝里
lines.en: A shot lodges in my armour's seam.

lines.zh: 那股力量绕开了我的气
lines.en: That force slipped past my ki.

lines.zh: 空着肚子,气就提不起来
lines.en: Empty, and my ki will not rise.

lines.zh: 雷击让我整条手臂发麻
lines.en: Lightning leaves my whole arm numb.
There is nowhere to plant my feet.
